title: Amazonian
summary: AMAZO'NIAN, adjective 1. Pertaining to or resembling an Amazon. Applied to females, bold; of masculine manners; warlike. 2. Belonging to the river Maranon in South America, or to Amazonia, the country

inlines.v: AMAZO'NIAN, adjective 1. Pertaining to or resembling an Amazon. Applied to females, bold; of masculine manners; warlike. 2. Belonging to the river Maranon in South America, or to Amazonia, the country lying on that river.
